Rafael M.: Quick one — using the "Docs try-it" embedded component to exercise the browser quickstart (iframe in docs). When I click "Run" the network call returns 403 billing_required. The error in the embedded console is just `billing_required` with no link. The org is SSO-provisioned. Anyone seen the embedded docs flow hide the billing CTA?
Kara (devex): hmm interesting. Embedded iframe flows sometimes get special UX because we sanitize links. Can you paste the network response and the iframe JS console output?
Rafael M.: network response from the iframe:
```json
{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"Workspace 6600 requires payment method"}}
```
iframe console shows a popup blocked when it tries to open the billing URL (window.open) and no visible CTA. The full billing URL from the response is `https://console.redwood.example/orgs/6600/billing`.
Ben (sdk): two possible things colliding: 1) the console UI intentionally prevents navigation from embedded contexts (clickjacking mitigation) so the iframe can't surface the add-card flow, 2) SCIM-created org might be onboard_state=provisioned which hides the normal CTA. Combined they leave the embedded user stuck.
Rafael M.: right — i tried clicking the small link and nothing happened (popup blocked). Right-click -> open in new tab works but most users won't do that.
Kara (devex): workaround: docs should show a short note under the embedded runner that says "If you see billing_required when using the embedded runner, open the billing page in a new tab or use the console to add a card (admins only)." We'll add a small ui affordance (external link icon) so users can open console in new tab.
Rafael M.: for internal test I opened the billing page myself and the add-card button was missing — admin complained they couldn't see the form.
infra-bot: Found org 6600: plan=unconfigured, onboard_state=provisioned, payment_method=null. Creating ticket INFRA-9311 to backfill SCIM onboarding and ensure provisioned orgs can surface the add-card form in console for admin users.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-8404: "Console prevents add-card flow from embedded contexts; supply safe external link for try-it runner".
Ben (sdk): on the SDK/docs side i'll add a short note in the embedded runner code to open the billing url in a new tab if a 403 is returned and include a small troubleshooting popup that explains SSO/SCIM provisioning edge cases. Also adding a unit test for the runner to detect 403::billing_required.
Kara (devex): action items: 1) update docs try-it copy and place an external open link, 2) add quickstart FAQ entry: "If you are using embedded runner and get billing_required, open the billing page in a new tab and ask your admin to add a card; SCIM-provisioned orgs may need infra help.", 3) link INFRA-9311 and BILL-8404 in the FAQ so support can triage faster.
Rafael M.: workaround worked for me (opened in new tab, admin could add card, sample returned 200). Thanks. Please ping when docs PR lands.
Kara (devex): will open PR and tag you. Closing thread once docs and runner change land. :rocket:
